verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm finance users can create, customize, brand, and send Stripe-hosted invoices from the Dashboard with no code (stripe-docs-21, stripe-docs-60), within Billing's invoicing scope (stripe-docs-51). Online payment on the invoice is only implied by 'Stripe-hosted', and automatic reminders are not documented; Smart Retries covers retrying failed payments, not invoice reminders (stripe-docs-14). Missing for 10: explicit evidence of online payment on hosted invoices, automatic payment reminder emails, independent or hands-on corroboration.
